description: Work out the minimum number of staff a licensed childcare center needs for a group of children in one US state, from that state's staff-to-child ratio for 3-year-olds, 4-year-olds or school-age children. Returns staff needed (children divided by the ratio, rounded up), the ratio, the maximum group size where the state sets one, caveats and backpr.com links. If BackPR couldn't confirm a ratio for that age group, it says so instead of guessing. General information, not legal advice.

children.description: Number of children in the group, from 1 to 1000.

state.description: US state name or 2-letter code, case-insensitive, such as "Texas" or "TX". "DC" and "District of Columbia" also work.

name: calculate_staff_needed

ages.description: The state's label for this age band

minimum_groups.description: Fewest groups the children must be split into under the maximum group size

ratio.description: Children per adult; null if BackPR couldn't confirm it

source_url.description: The ratios section of the state's backpr.com rules page

staff_needed.description: Minimum staff: children divided by the ratio, rounded up

title: Calculate staff needed
